title: Lower bound for layer vertex indices
statement: Let $F$ be a finite layered Boolean circuit whose gates use only identity, NOT, and unbounded fan-in AND operations. If $m+1<\mathrm{depth}(F)+1$ and $u$ is a node in layer $m+1$, then the index assigned to $u$ is at least $n$ plus the cumulative number of nodes in the successor layers preceding layer $m$.
hypotheses_covered: $F$ is a layered circuit over $\mathrm{Fin}\,2$ with $n$ inputs and output type $\mathrm{Unit}$
Every gate operation of $F$ is identity, NOT, or unbounded fan-in AND
